Bundled frontend assets
=======================

The following assets are bundled so Bank Analyzer can operate without
runtime access to third-party CDNs.

- Bootstrap 5.3.0
  License: MIT
  Source: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap

- Bootstrap Icons 1.11.0
  License: MIT
  Source: https://github.com/twbs/icons

- Plotly.js 2.27.0
  License: MIT
  Source: https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js

- SortableJS 1.15.6
  License: MIT
  Source: https://github.com/SortableJS/Sortable

Assets retrieved on 2026-07-26 from the version-pinned distribution URLs
referenced by the project before bundling.
